problem: University students struggle to find compatible peers for study groups outside of class, leading to isolated studying and lower academic engagement.
target_user: University students looking for collaborative study partners for their enrolled courses.
goals: Enable students to create profiles and link their current university courses.
Match students based on course overlap, free time availability, and study style preferences.
Provide a basic in-app messaging or connection request system to facilitate group formation.
non_goals: Building an integrated video conferencing or screen-sharing tool.
Integrating with official university LMS platforms like Canvas or Blackboard via paid APIs.
Monetizing the platform or processing payments.
requirements: User authentication via university email domain.
Profile management including course list, availability schedule, and study style tags.
Matching algorithm comparing course codes, overlapping time slots, and study preferences.
Simple direct messaging between matched study group members.

user_stories.i_want: to create an account using my university email
user_stories.so_that: I can access the study group platform securely and verify my student status
acceptance_criteria: User can sign up with an email and password
System validates that the email ends with a university domain
User receives a confirmation prompt upon successful registration

user_stories.i_want: to update my profile with my current courses, availability, and study style
user_stories.so_that: the matching system can find compatible peers for me
acceptance_criteria: User can add and remove courses with course codes
User can select weekly availability hours on a calendar interface
User can choose study style preferences from a predefined list (e.g., quiet, discussion-based, project-focused)

user_stories.i_want: to view a list of suggested study partners based on my profile
user_stories.so_that: I can find students taking the same classes with matching schedules
acceptance_criteria: System calculates overlap in courses and available time slots
System displays a list of matched users ordered by compatibility score
User can view basic profile details of potential matches

user_stories.i_want: to send a connection request to another student
user_stories.so_that: we can form a study group together
acceptance_criteria: User can click a button to send a connection request
Target user receives a notification of the pending request
Target user can accept or decline the request

user_stories.as_a: student in an accepted study pair or group
user_stories.i_want: to chat with my matched peers within the app
user_stories.so_that: we can coordinate meeting times and locations
acceptance_criteria: Users with accepted connections can access a chat interface
Messages are sent and displayed in real-time or via polling
Chat history is persisted in the database
All features must function correctly across modern desktop and mobile web browsers.
User data such as schedules and email addresses must be securely handled.
The matching algorithm must return results in under two seconds.

risks.description: Low initial user adoption on campus leading to empty matching pools.
Complex schedule overlap logic taking longer than expected to implement within the 5-week timeframe.
